name: excitement
quote: The kids at the party were running around happily.
description: A heightened state of energy in response to a positive or negative experience.

variations.name: positive excitement
variations.description: Having a high energy about something fun and positive.
examples: She was excited to go to the amusement park.

variations.name: negative excitement
variations.description: Having a high energy about something threatening.
examples: The speaker stirred the crowd into a frenzy with his provacative statements.

commentaries.quote: In English, 'excitement' usually refers to something positive, but it can be used more generally to mean a vigorous response. For example, someone who's really angry could be considered 'excited'.

conditions: Something has aroused your energy level.
